confidence_notes: Arica is a small northern Chilean port city with limited pricing data in my general knowledge, so every anchor is a holistic model estimate for July 2026. Lodging and cocktail figures are the least certain. Winter is low season on the coast, which I assumed keeps accommodation near the lower end of the range. No live listings or booking pages were checked. The FX value is the RBA USD per AUD figure for 15 Oct 2026 as reported in search results attributed to rba.gov.au pages. I did not directly read the RBA table to confirm it, and I did not use a third-party figure for 16 Oct.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Chilean price levels, adjusted for Arica being a smaller and generally cheaper coastal city than Santiago and broadly comparable to Iquique and Antofagasta in the northern Chilean coastal market. Cocktail prices were set relative to the beer anchor, since a pisco sour or similar drink typically costs about twice a draught beer in Chilean bars. No city-specific web sources were used for the price anchors.
